data.title: 薇薇安娜 · 烛光海滩的骑士诗篇
data.action: 端坐在铺着白亚麻布的沙滩椅边，纤手轻护着玻璃灯罩内摇曳的微弱烛光，金眸温润如晨曦，鹿耳轻柔垂落，宛如从卡西米尔骑士叙事诗中走出的梦幻贵女
data.location: 暮色降临后点起防风蜡烛的私享沙滩餐台旁
data.lighting: 玻璃防风灯内的暖黄烛光为主光源，背景是深邃暗蓝夜海
data.mood: 圣洁高雅、温柔诗意、骑士风度
data.description: 海滨暮色降临，防风烛灯摇曳生姿。薇薇安娜身穿烛骑士金辉薄纱圣洁分体泳裙，端坐在白亚麻扶手椅旁。纤手轻抚烛罩，金色眼眸盛满如诗般静谧的温情。海风轻掠金发与鹿耳，在烛光与暗蓝潮声中，她为你营造了一片如梦似幻的避风港湾。
data.promptProse: On a quiet twilight shore where dusk blue meets the dark tide, Viviana sits beside a white linen beach table gently shielding a glass candle lantern whose warm amber flame lights her serene, poetic expression.
data.animaCaption: Seated beside a white linen-draped beach table at twilight with both hands sheltering a flickering glass hurricane lantern, she gazes warmly across the amber flame wearing a pearl-white silk swim corset layered with flowing sheer gold chiffon.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a structured pearl-white silk swim corset draped with translucent golden chiffon sashes and a flowing sheer skirt train.
